title: Construction of a metaverse integrated with digital twins and physical sensors
author: Marlon Wendrer Jacinto
abstract: This work presents a functional architecture for integrating the metaverse, digital twins, and physical sensors connected via the Internet of Things (IoT). The proposed system consists of a 3D immersive virtnal environment developed in Unity, capable of real-time reflection of physical data such as luminosity.
